in_arabic.name: Fariishta
in_arabic.meaning: اسم عربي يعني Lady of Paradise
in_arabic.long_meaning: Fariishta هو اسم عربي إسلامي يحمل معنى عميقاً في الثقافة الإسلامية. In Persian, Fariishta refers to the lady of paradise. This name is derived from the Persian word 'far-ishterd', which means 'to protect', indicating the protector and caretaker of paradise.
